# Chapter 7: Factors in Maximal Hypertrophic Development

Several population-specific factors affect skeletal muscle mass and the hypertrophic response to resistance exercise. Of particular note are genetics, age, sex, and training experience. This chapter provides an overview of these factors and their effects on the ability to increase muscle size.
